primary_spec.scorer: signed cosine, V-centred full 512-d, per layer (12)
primary_spec.detection: within-TF label permutation applied jointly to 12 layers, N=10,000, stats3.max_t_adjust tail='greater'
primary_spec.intervals: two-way TF x target cluster bootstrap B=2,000 (stats3 weight stream), percentile 95% CI + one-sided 95% UB
primary_spec.comparator: |Pearson r| on expr_extraction.npy (primary) and expr.npy (3,000 cells), paired delta on same resamples
primary_spec.decision: detected: min p_maxT<0.05; AUROC>=0.60 excluded: all UB<0.60; not above co-expression: all delta UB<0.05

implementation_notes: Bootstrap and permutation use vectorised evaluators (e4a_lib.py) verified equal to stats3 (point, two-way and TF-only bootstrap replicates from the same seed, permuted-label AUROC); max abs diff recorded.
Permutation random stream differs from StratifiedPairs.permute_within_tf (vectorised generator of the same within-TF permutation distribution).
rank-k and band scorers, strata on large contexts and ChIP outside lung/lung_external use the first 1,000 of the 2,000 resamples / B=1,000.
Strata: positives restricted, all candidate non-edges of each TF kept; TF detection = fraction of extraction cells with expression > 0.
